messages:
maya.design: Short accessibility pass on the Models table after today's UI tweaks. Found a few quick wins around keyboard nav, virtualized rows, and pill contrast. TL;DR: focus needs to follow selection, kebab must be tabbable, avoid header duplication for SR, and darken pills at small sizes.
leo.frontend: thanks — paste repros and I'll take the fixes.
anya.a11y: high level: (1) sync DOM focus when arrow-nav moves selection, (2) ensure action buttons are in tab order even with virtualization, (3) remove duplicated labelledby/headers causing double announcements, (4) raise pill contrast tokens.
maya.design: 1) Arrow keys move the visual highlight but browser focus stays put. Keyboard users lose the focus ring when navigating rows.
  repro: Console > Models, use Down Arrow twice; visual selection moves but no element receives focus.
  suggested: when selection changes call element.focus() on the newly selected row or on the primary interactive child, and use :focus-visible CSS for keyboard-only rings.
leo.frontend: we set aria-selected only; I'll update the key handler to move DOM focus and add the focus-visible rule.
anya.a11y: prefer a semantic focusable (button/link) inside the row or set tabindex=0 on the row container. That improves SR announcement too.
maya.design: 2) Kebab/More buttons are skipped during Tab for many virtualized rows 1; tabbing jumps past until the row is clicked or expanded.
  repro: Tab from top-of-page; several rows' kebab buttons never get focus unless the row is interacted with.
  suggested: keep the action control rendered as a tabbable element even when rows are virtualized. If you use clones for perf, mark visual-only clones aria-hidden=true but maintain one tabbable control per logical row.
leo.frontend: virtualization is the wrinkle. I'll ensure the kebab is always present in DOM with tabindex=0 and toggle visual-only attributes.
rory.qa: I'll add an E2E that tabs across 12 rows and asserts each kebab got focus in order.
maya.design: 3) Screen readers repeat the column header when landing on the first cell (e.g., "Name, Models, row 3 of 8, Name"). Seems like duplicated reference.
  repro: VoiceOver/NVDA both show duplicated header text for some cells.
  likely cause: extra aria-labelledby on the cell that references the header in addition to native th relationships.
anya.a11y: audit labelledby/describedby chains. Remove redundant aria-labelledby from cells; use aria-describedby for supplementary info. If using role=grid, ensure role=row/role=gridcell pairing is consistent.
leo.frontend: will strip unnecessary labelledby attributes and re-run SR tests.
maya.design: 4) Status pills (experimental/deprecated) look low contrast at small sizes (~2.7:1). They read faint.
  suggestion: introduce semantic tokens like --status-pill-text and --status-pill-bg and pick a darker text token (or slightly darker bg) to hit at least 3:1, preferably 4.5:1 for normal text.
leo.frontend: will propose token alternatives and post before/after screenshots in the PR.
anya.a11y: small copy/accessibility nit: kebab aria-label is the generic "More". For SR users prefer `aria-label="More actions for <model name>"` so each control announces context.
leo.frontend: agreed, will generate aria-label per-row: `aria-label={`More actions for ${model.name}`}`.
sasha.pm: timeline? focus + kebab tabbability seems P0 for keyboard users. Can we aim to land those this sprint?
leo.frontend: yes, splitting into two PRs: (A) focus movement + kebab tabbability (P0) due in 3 biz days, (B) pill tokens + SR attribute cleanup (P1) next week.
anya.a11y: ping me on PR A for quick review; I'll add a tiny checklist to the component README: "move DOM focus on arrow nav", "action buttons tabbable under virtualization", "no duplicated labelledby on cells", "pills meet contrast target".
rory.qa: I'll add keyboard tab-order and VO assertion tests once PRs are up.
maya.design: thanks team 1 I'll attach token suggestions and screenshots in the PR thread.
leo.frontend: thanks, will open PRs and link this thread.
